title: Deep-research Boğaziçi food operations and procurement
acceptance_criteria: Official Boğaziçi food-service governance, digital signals, service regimes and procurement structure are mapped with provenance and caveats
Public clues about BUCard/QR/menu votes are never promoted to claims of private data access
Official-source metric conflicts are preserved in a reconciliation artifact rather than silently normalized
Current successful 2026-2027 tender is distinguished from the cancelled predecessor by IKN
Procurement quantities, unit-price structure, daily capacity requirement and contract value are represented without treating contract value as food-waste cost
IE, EE, CS1 and CS2 receive actionable PMR/data/model handoffs
Machine-readable JSON companions expose findings, source conflicts, candidate data, contract unknowns and role handoffs
